title: Yoisaki Kanade — Thinking Of Who It's For〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find some scented oils that we liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. There were so many at first that I really didn't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we really started having fun partway through.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all enjoyed yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Next, why don't we choose some flowers to put inside our scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Flowers?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, dried flowers to be exact.
They can help give a candle a more elegant look when placed inside of its wax.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow. This one looks like it has a flower inside it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I believe that's a hydrangea. It's so vivid and pretty...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like they have several with different species of flowers in them. Oh, this one even has an orange and other fruits in it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It does. That's really cute...
The others would probably be so startled if I made something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means our candles might turn out like the ones we saw earlier.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They'd look so pretty and colorful. Ena and the others would probably like that.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Found it! Right over here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, they have so many different kinds of dried flowers. Um... This one looks kinda familiar, but I forget its name...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's baby's-breath. The ones next to them are petunias and... Oh, they even have lavender and starflowers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really do know your flowers, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, just their names if I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. The truth is, I'm always asking Ichika for advice regarding which flowers to take over to your house, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only can she tell me what's in season, but she can also tell me about their symbolism.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? That's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's nothing special. This is just a hobby of mine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I really appreciate what you do. The flowers you suggest have this way of brightening up my house.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, would you mind helping me pick out some today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, can you help me too...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I'd be more than happy to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should have just enough room to fit one of these larger flowers, so please keep that in mind. Outside of that, you should be free to choose whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, we'll probably want to choose ones that go with each candle's design.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We can also choose ones that are in season...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For example, pheasant's-eye and daffodils... Plum blossoms and camellias should also be in bloom soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Pheasant's-eye...? Oh, these. They come in such a beautiful yellow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They have an interesting name too.
I wonder what they symbolize...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they're supposed to symbolize “forthcoming happiness” or “eternal good fortune”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you knew that off the top of your head...? You really do know a lot about flowers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we keep asking our teacher Ms. Ichika here any questions that we have while choosing our flowers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Ms. Ichika?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to thank you as well, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You're both going along with this?! Again, what I do is really nothing special...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for teaching us so much today, Hoshino. I was able to pick out the right flowers because of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. You teaching us what our flowers symbolize helped so much. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I had fun as well. When I was double-checking, it was interesting to learn that certain flowers symbolized other things on top of what I already knew.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much, Ms. Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All that's left is to make our candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I hope our candles turn out well.
And I really hope everyone likes them.)
